create_composite_encoder: create a CompositeEncoder that wraps multiple FairseqEncoder objects into a single encoder
run_forward_composite_encoder: run forward on a CompositeEncoder to get outputs from all wrapped encoders as a dictionary
reorder_encoder_outputs: reorder the encoder outputs of a CompositeEncoder according to a new batch order
get_max_positions: get the minimum max_positions across all encoders in a CompositeEncoder
upgrade_state_dict_composite: upgrade the state dict by delegating to each encoder in a CompositeEncoder
